# Dipriva Consulting Group
# https://www.dipriva.com

> Dipriva Consulting Group is a bilingual
> (English/Spanish) executive consulting firm
> serving growth-oriented businesses in West
> Michigan. Founded by Manuel Diprés.

## Services
- [Startup Operations Consulting](https://www.dipriva.com/services/startup-operations):
  Operational structure and 90-day roadmap for
  founders of 10-50 person professional services
  firms.
- [Corporate Strategy Consulting](https://www.dipriva.com/services/corporate-strategy):
  Strategic decision architecture, competitive
  positioning, and execution roadmaps for West
  Michigan business owners and executives.
- [AI and Automation Consulting](https://www.dipriva.com/services/ai-automation):
  Workflow audit and AI implementation to
  eliminate operational drag.

## Geographic Focus
West Michigan mid-market; bilingual delivery
in English and Spanish.

## About
- [Manuel Diprés](https://www.dipriva.com/about/manuel-dipres):
  Founder with 20+ years experience in revenue
  operations, go-to-market systems, and
  operational consulting across the Americas
  and Europe.
